case_number: Civil Appeal Nos. 1144-1146 of 2011 (and related appeals)
summary: Land acquisition challenge; validity of acquisitions by private entity rebranded as public company; public purpose test for education project; quashal of notifications under s.4(1), s.6 of Land Acquisition Act, 1894; alleged mala fide requisition; restoration of land ownership; applicability of Part VII provisions; High Court upheld PIL challenging acquisition affecting 6000 families; impugned High Court order quashing entire acquisition process under appeal.
legal_provisions_cited: Orissa Industrial Infrastructural Development Corporation Act, 1980 s.15
